title: Content lifecycle gates
description: The five actions that cannot be completed by an agent alone. Gates sit only where an action is hard to undo; everything cheap and reversible runs freely. A gate on a cheap action is friction that teaches people to click through gates.

statements.label: Every file write is proposed as a diff
statements.requirement: An agent SHALL NOT write to the working tree directly. Every proposed change SHALL be presented as a diff against the current content, and SHALL land only on an explicit apply action by a person. What a model proposed and what a person accepted SHALL remain separate records.

statements.label: IG Publisher runs only on explicit confirmation
statements.requirement: Invoking the IG Publisher SHALL require explicit confirmation and SHALL be serialised behind a lock. The run costs minutes and a 6 GB JVM; it is not a background convenience.

statements.label: Regeneration stops before overwriting hand-edited content
statements.requirement: A regeneration that would overwrite hand-edited FSH or any other hand-authored artifact SHALL stop and ask. It SHALL NOT silently reconcile, and SHALL NOT choose a winner on the agent's own judgment.

statements.label: L2 content is reviewed before transformation
statements.requirement: L2 content SHALL be declared ready and confirmed by a Content Reviewer before L3 transformation begins. Transformation of unreviewed L2 propagates defects into artifacts that are more expensive to correct.

statements.label: Draft concepts block release
statements.requirement: Release SHALL be authorised by the Commons and Governance Steward. Every logical model data element SHALL map to a WHO Commons concept. Draft concepts are permitted during authoring and SHALL block release.

statements.label: Fidelity is never auto-passed
statements.requirement: Tier 3 fidelity — whether an L3 artifact faithfully represents its L2 source — SHALL NOT be marked passed by any automated check. A validation report SHALL record it as requiring a human ruling until a person rules on it. Mechanical checks verify form; none of them verifies meaning.
